about: Built by tools/build-turn2-puzzles.js from docs/agents/turn2-hands.json (T-096). The hands are real goldfish games: G.newGame(deck, opts + onPlay, seed) then G.mulligan. Opponent habit: it uses its counterspell on the first spell it legally can.

oracle.name: Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation
oracle.text: Demonic Consultation names a card that is not in your library and exiles the whole library; Thassa's Oracle then enters with an empty library and wins. In ICEYfish the two are cast as one step, so the opponent cannot respond to the finish, only to the cards that set it up.

breach.name: Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond + Brain Freeze
breach.text: Underworld Breach lets you recast spells from the graveyard (sacrificing them at the end of turn). Lion's Eye Diamond gives three mana for your hand, and Brain Freeze with storm mills every library until nobody can draw.

monolith.name: Basalt Monolith + Kinnan or Rings of Brighthearth, then Walking Ballista or Thrasios
monolith.text: Basalt Monolith taps for three and untaps for three. Kinnan (or Rings of Brighthearth) makes that loop make mana without end, and Walking Ballista (or Thrasios finding it) turns infinite mana into the win.

packages.name: Force of Will
packages.why: Free: it exiles a blue card from its hand and pays 1 life to counter any spell. Tapping out changes nothing.

packages.name: Force of Will + Swords + Bojuka Bog
packages.why: Force of Will (free counter), Swords to Plowshares (exiles your first creature), and Bojuka Bog as its land drop (exiles your graveyard before turn 2).

packages.name: Force of Will + Swords + Rest in Peace
packages.why: Force of Will (free counter), Swords to Plowshares, and Rest in Peace already in play: your graveyard is gone, and Underworld Breach needs it.

packages.name: Force of Will + Swords + Drannith Magistrate
packages.why: Force of Will (free counter), Swords to Plowshares, and Drannith Magistrate already in play: a commander cannot be cast from the command zone.
